Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.coverage

Class Coverage

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.coverage.Coverage
public class Coverage extends Object
DTO for coverage (raster layer) details.

Maps the response body of GET /rest/workspaces/{ws}/coveragestores/{cs}/coverages/{name}.

GeoServer returns many fields (grid, dimensions, parameters, etc.). This DTO maps only the commonly used ones; unknown fields are silently ignored via @JsonIgnoreProperties(ignoreUnknown = true).
